title: On-page SEO check
purpose: Review on-page relevance, structure, metadata, and evidence alignment without mutating published content.
whenToUse: Reviewing page titles, headings, intent fit, content structure, internal links, and on-page signals.
requiredInputs: Observed metadata and link evidence when available
steps: Review title, heading, and content structure.
checks: Do not invent rankings, keyword volume, or page performance.
Do not mutate pages or invoke external optimization tooling in P9-0H.
outputs: Advisory on-page findings and prioritized improvement plan.
evidenceRules: Observed evidence must stay distinct from recommendations and third-party method guidance.
Missing observed data remains unknown and must never be converted to zero, failure, or success.
Any externally sourced benchmark or claim must retain provenance and applicability limits.
forbiddenInferences: Do not fabricate rankings, citations, traffic, conversions, backlinks, performance, or verification state.
Do not elevate advisory output into P7 authoritative facts, deterministic scores, P8 risk, approvals, mutation authority, or VERIFIED status.
Do not request or use credentials, execute commands, call networks, mutate databases, publish, deploy, merge, or perform runtime actions.
